prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: SKY-ONLY photographic atmospheric texture for a world-fixed spherical sky cap in an actual 3D scene. Create an independent new image of only sky, never a replacement scene. Wide 2:1 image. This is NOT a full360 panorama: it depicts a70-degree-wide,35-degree-high angular section of sky, from elevation30degrees at the top to elevation-5degrees at the bottom. The astronomical horizon is at86percent image height. No ground is visible at or below that line: use only atmospheric haze in the last14percent.
Reference input role: only the small scattered sunset cloud forms, soft pale blue gaps, and gold rim lighting of the reference sky. Absolutely exclude every building, roof, tree, leaf, mountain, water, garden, object and silhouette from the reference.
Camera/lighting calibration: the actual sun is OUTSIDE the image, about8degrees beyond its LEFT edge, at elevation13.5degrees, corresponding to47percent image height. Do not include a solar disk or a central white glare. The left quarter is softly luminous honey-gold and pale apricot; the center and right are pale powder-blue with gently warm broken cloud rims. Clouds are lit from the upper-left/off-left sun. Show delicate natural gray-lavender undersides, clear luminous thin irregular golden edges, fine white-gold filaments. Preserve large clean blue gaps between individual clouds. Sky blue and cloud shading should have a convincing restrained photographic response rather than orange paint.
Cloud composition: a natural field of40to70separate small irregular broken altocumulus/stratocumulus tufts spread through the image, each typically2to5percent of image width, some joining in loose thin clusters. About35percent cloud cover and65percent clear pale blue/warm transparent atmosphere. Clouds appear at realistic infinite distance with crisp fine edge detail, airy rounded volume, and substantial clear spaces. No single huge cloud, no solid overcast ceiling, no large banks that fill most of the picture. At the bottom, very small thin distant clouds mixed into golden horizon haze; at the top, pale blue and a few small airy warm-white fragments. Texture should be naturally detailed at full image resolution, no shallow depth of field, no blur, no painterly smoothing.
Strict exclusions: architecture, temples, buildings, rooftops, trees, foliage, flowers, plants, mountains, terrain, water, ocean, people, silhouettes, objects, sun disk, moon, stars, lens flare, beams, artificial glow blobs, text, labels, watermark, border. Only independent photographic atmosphere and small sunset clouds.

radiance.interpretation: Artistic LDR sRGB camera-sky proxy, hardware-decoded to linear and multiplied1.1 inside the scene linear render target before existing ACES OutputPass. The measured Qwantani CC0 environment PMREM remains unmodified, at intensity.38.

calibration.coordinateConvention: Longitude atan2(worldZ,worldX), latitude asin(worldY). World fixed; re-centered sphere removes translation parallax. TextureLoader flipY converts PNG top-origin texture V.
calibration.projection: Spherical cap with linear longitude and latitude. Scene camera/main geometry are not used as projection inputs.
calibration.outsideCap: Original measured Qwantani HDRI using original aligned rotation and display gain.08.
